description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Special Direction under Section 10(1)(b)(ii) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003
categorisation: This gazette contains a Special Direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003, which establishes regulatory requirements for manufacturers and traders regarding specific goods. It creates legal obligations and compliance requirements for businesses, making it a regulatory matter that falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories.
